create.name: Kate Johnson
create.bio:
Kate Johnson is a Buddhist meditation teacher, writer and facilitator who brings together insight practice, somatic movement and creativity. Raised in Chicago, she trained in dance at the Ailey School and Fordham University and took a master's in performance studies at NYU before turning to contemplative work. In 2011 she co-founded the meditation group within Occupy Wall Street, later trained in Social Presencing Theater with the Presencing Institute, and was authorised to teach in the Theravada and Western Insight lineage in 2020 after Spirit Rock's four-year retreat teacher training, with Gina Sharpe, Larry Yang and Lila Kate Wheeler as her guides. African and African diasporic religious paths also sit at the centre of her own practice.

She now serves on the teachers' councils of Spirit Rock and True North Insight and leads residential retreats, including retreats for women and for people of colour, alongside online programmes and monthly one-to-one meditation mentoring. Her book Radical Friendship draws on the Buddha's teaching on spiritual friendship to offer seven ways of living one's values in every relationship. She also designs staff retreats for organisations, weaving dialogue, creative group practice and care for the nervous system.

books.title: Radical Friendship: Seven Ways to Love Yourself and Find Your People in an Unjust World
books.author: Kate Johnson
books.description: Building on the Buddha's teaching about spiritual friendship, the book sets out seven practices for bringing love, courage and trust into all our relationships. It treats friendship as a spiritual path and a way of living one's values among others.

courses.title: Already Good: A BIPOC Retreat on Bodhicitta (True North Insight)
courses.description: A weekend meditation retreat for Black, Indigenous and people of colour, held in forest by the Ottawa River with True North Insight. The weekend centres on our basic goodness and the awakened heart.

courses.title: The Spirit of Creativity: Awakening the Heart through Meditation, Qigong, Story, and Song
courses.description: A residential retreat at Spirit Rock that treats making art as dharma practice, with meditation, qigong, storytelling and song. Her co-teachers are Anne Cushman, Chenxing Han, Sam Rise and Roshi Teja Bell.

courses.title: Rest, Renewal, and Liberation: A Women's Meditation Retreat
courses.description: A week-long silent retreat for women and gender-expansive people, taught by Kate with a team of four other teachers. Teachings explore the three characteristics of experience and what they show about self and freedom.

courses.title: One on One Meditation Mentorship
courses.description: Monthly hour-long mentoring sessions over six months for committed practitioners, with tailored guided meditations and context from Buddhist psychology. Places open through a waiting list.
